title: B-Rank Adventurer With an Evil Look Becomes a Daddy to the Protagonist and His Childhood Friends
description: Gray, a B-rank adventurer, was supposed to be just a mob character in the RPG “Bright Fantasy”. However, by chance, he saved an orphan who was attacked by thugs on the roadside and decided to raise him as his father. But the orphan turned out to be the hero of this world, “Iska”. This choice would greatly change the fate of the world. B-Grade Adventurer With a Bad Guy Face – Becomes a Daddy to the Hero and His Fellow Children, Akuninzura shita B-kyuu Boukensha – Shujinkou to Sono Osananajimi-tachi no Papa ni naru , 悪人面したＢ級冒険者, 悪人面したＢ級冒険者 主人公とその幼馴染たちのパパになる
